# Get column descriptions from BIRD's CSV
        desc_csv = env.description(table)
        desc_lines = desc_csv.strip().split('\n') if desc_csv else []
        desc_dict = {}
        for line in desc_lines:
            if ',' in line:
                parts = line.split(',', 1)
                if len(parts) >= 2:
                    col_name = parts[0].strip()
                    desc = parts[1].strip()
                    desc_dict[col_name] = desc
        described = []
        for info in info_rows:
            col_name = info[1]
            col_type = info[2]
            desc = desc_dict.get(col_name, "No description available")
            described.append(f"{col_name} ({col_type}) - {desc}")
        described_str = ", ".join(described)
        lines.append(f"Table {table}: {described_str}")
